svg.aria-label: The prompt patch loop in four stages: a nightly proposer drafts the smallest fix, a decision webhook applies or rejects it with a single-use token, a rollback webhook restores the previous prompt in one click, and a monthly consolidation review keeps the prompt coherent.

g.text: Stage 1 / propose (nightly) (trunk path shown: 15 of 17 nodes)
Stage 2 / decide (apply or reject) (trunk path shown: 11 of 22 nodes)
Stage 3 / rollback (one click) (trunk path shown: 9 of 10 nodes)
